name: Barcode Scanner
description: Scan a barcode with the kiosk camera and send it to Home Assistant as a kiosk_barcode_scanned event. Start a scan from a gesture, the drawer or a Home Assistant button.
author: syphernl

settings.title: Codes
settings.description: Product barcodes reads EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and UPC-E. All codes also reads QR codes and the other formats, a bit slower.

settings.title: Camera
settings.description: The lens the scanner opens with. The flip button in the scanner switches it.

settings.title: Timeout
settings.description: The scanner closes when it reads nothing in this time.

settings.title: Scanner message
settings.default: Hold the barcode inside the frame.
